mapper.sql: select r.room_id,r.room_name,r.location,r.room_type, case when count(distinct w.mentor_id)=1 then min(w.mentor_id) else null end mentor_id, group_concat(distinct u.nick_name order by u.nick_name separator '、') mentor_name,r.status,r.remark, count(w.workstation_id) workstation_count, coalesce(sum(w.status='AVAILABLE'),0) available_count, coalesce(sum(w.status in ('IN_USE','PENDING_RETURN')),0) in_use_count, coalesce(sum(w.status='DISABLED'),0) disabled_count from gw_room r left join gw_workstation w on w.room_id=r.room_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=w.mentor_id
mapper.select:
and r.room_name like concat('%', #{roomName}, '%') and r.room_type = #{roomType} and exists(select 1 from gw_workstation owned where owned.room_id=r.room_id and owned.mentor_id=#{mentorId}) and r.status = #{status} and r.room_type='STUDIO' and r.status='NORMAL' and exists(select 1 from gw_workstation free where free.room_id=r.room_id) and not exists(select 1 from gw_workstation owned where owned.room_id=r.room_id and (owned.mentor_id is not null or owned.status not in ('AVAILABLE','DISABLED')))
group by r.room_id,r.room_name,r.location,r.room_type,r.status,r.remark order by r.room_id desc

select r.room_id,r.room_name,r.location,r.room_type,r.mentor_id,u.nick_name mentor_name,r.status,r.remark, 0 workstation_count,0 available_count,0 in_use_count,0 disabled_count from gw_room r left join sys_user u on u.user_id=r.mentor_id where r.room_id=#{roomId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into gw_room(room_name, location, room_type, status, remark, create_by, create_time) values(#{roomName}, #{location}, #{roomType}, ifnull(#{status}, 'NORMAL'), #{remark}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update gw_room set room_name = #{roomName}, location = #{location}, room_type=#{roomType}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where room_id = #{roomId}
mapper.select: select (select count(1) from gw_workstation where room_id=#{roomId}) + (select count(1) from gw_inspection_task where room_id=#{roomId}) + (select count(1) from gw_studio_application where room_id=#{roomId})
select count(1) from gw_workstation where room_id=#{roomId}
select count(1) from gw_assignment a join gw_workstation w on w.workstation_id=a.workstation_id where w.room_id=#{roomId} and a.ended_at is null
select count(1) from gw_studio_application where room_id=#{roomId} and status='PENDING'
mapper.update: update gw_room set mentor_id=#{mentorId},update_time=now() where room_id=#{roomId} and room_type='STUDIO' and status='NORMAL' and mentor_id is null
update gw_room set mentor_id=null,update_time=now() where room_id=#{roomId} and mentor_id=#{mentorId}
